title: The Sinful Nature
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The sinful nature means that fallen humanity is inwardly bent away from God in desires, thoughts, motives, and will. Sin is not only what people do; it is also a corruption within the heart.
summary: The sinful nature means that fallen humanity is inwardly bent away from God in desires, thoughts, motives, and will. Sin is not only what people do; it is also a corruption within the heart.
christFocus: Jesus Christ saves sinners from the guilt and power of sin and gives new life by the Spirit. In Him, believers are no longer ruled by the old self but are being renewed into holiness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture teaches that sin reaches inward. People commit sinful acts because the heart itself is corrupted. Desires, motives, thoughts, and loves are disordered apart from grace.

The sinful nature does not mean people are as outwardly evil as possible at every moment. It means the whole person is affected by sin and unable to love God perfectly apart from His saving work.

Jesus taught that evil proceeds from within the human heart. This confronts the idea that the main problem is outside us. Circumstances may influence, tempt, or wound people, but the sinful heart still needs redemption.

In Christ, believers put off the old self and put on the new. The sinful nature must not be excused, but neither is it stronger than the grace and Spirit of God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People often focus only on outward behavior while ignoring the heart. This leads to surface-level religion that may change appearances without addressing pride, unbelief, lust, anger, and idolatry within.

This doctrine helps believers fight sin honestly. They learn to pray for deeper transformation, not merely better habits. Christ came to save whole sinners, including the inward places only God fully sees.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask God to search your heart, not merely your outward actions. Confess sinful desires and motives, bring them under Scripture, and depend on the Spirit to put off the old self. Do not despair over the battle, but fight from the grace and new life given in Christ.
